product: ResumePilot AI User Dashboard & Resume Studio

exportAndDownloadIntegrity.notes: Direct authenticated PDF and DOCX downloads from both Dashboard Resume Cards and Resume Studio Preview Modal; zero OCC errors or data loss

atsIntelligenceIntegration.notes: Interactive ATS Score Pill in studio header with detailed 5-factor slide-over companion drawer and actionable keyword suggestions

accessibilityAndResponsiveness.notes: Full keyboard CBT navigation in Interview Simulator, aria-labels across all controls, anti-occlusion bottom footer padding, 10-viewport responsiveness

securityAndIdorProtection.notes: Bearer token enforcement, owner-scoped MariaDB SQL queries, TOTP 2FA, GDPR data portability, zero secret leakage to browser DOM
